coursework.summary: IP Paris Master M1/M2 2026–27 rules allow specified non-exam support with disclosure and course restrictions.

exams.summary: Examination AI use requires explicit instructor authorization in the covered Master scope.

ai_disclosure.summary: The covered Master rules require detailed disclosure for permitted non-exam use and academic citation when exam use is authorized.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Confidentiality requirements are recorded; AI vendor upload, retention and account controls are not established.

academic_integrity.summary: The covered Master rules treat unauthorized AI use in examinations as fraud and reproducing generated content beyond short cited excerpts as plagiarism.

approved_tools.summary: A member-school instructor resource catalog lists detection-related tools; institutional or student access/approval is not established.

teaching_guidance.summary: École polytechnique publishes instructor-facing AI resources; this does not establish IP Paris-wide or student guidance.

research_guidance.summary: The Master regulation requires research confidentiality but does not establish AI research or publication guidance.

security_procurement.summary: The reviewed public record contains no established security or procurement policy conclusion; source access and program coverage remain incomplete.
